model.transfer: original FP32 files kept on the local machine; after the job starts they are streamed through the login node with 'srun --jobid --overlap' into the node's $TMPDIR, SHA256 checked per file; never stored in the home area

experiment_A.tables: theta_S teacher forcing at each depth for fit, calibration and confirm documents

H.rows: one per scored line and previous depth (line 1: depth 16 only)

experiment_A.alpha_selection: 5-fold grouped cross-validation by document on the fit set, squared error; per-dimension standardisation, intercept unpenalised
experiment_A.decision: argmin_d [ell_hat(d) + kappa_s * shortfall(d) + kappa_e * excess(d) + nu * r(d)], history from executed depths
experiment_A.calibration_check: two policies per family nearest 0.5 executed online on calibration; |online - predicted| <= 0.01
experiment_A.primary: g_A = L_R(0.5) - L_H(0.5), each L_a(B) the exact loss of the cost-B mixture of the adjacent pair bracketing B on the confirm set

test.conclusions: see plan section 4.6 (two-directional: lower bound > 0, upper end < 0.005)

experiment_A.bracket_failure: any resample without a bracketing pair for either family makes the interval not estimable; no clipping, no dropping

arms.C: generation + control gradients summed, one AdamW, clip the sum at 1
arms.D: generation gradient to AdamW 1 (weight decay 0.01), control gradient to AdamW 2 (weight decay 0), each clipped at 1, parameter update is the sum of both displacements

shared.control_objective: follow-up E-C: expected local cost + 0.1 CE + 0.01 Brier + 0.1 KL(p || p_ref theta_S)
shared.optimizer: AdamW lr 1e-4 cosine to 1e-5, warmup 5%, betas (0.9, 0.999), eps 1e-8
shared.history_and_order: derived from the training seed, identical rules across arms

primary.pooling: per-document mean over the three seeds, then document mean; document bootstrap conditional on the trained models

experiment_B.cross_seed_claim: requires all three per-seed estimates to share the sign of the pooled estimate; per-seed t interval (df 2) reported

secondary.deployment: seed 17 G, C, D deployed with head.pt; four b per model chosen on calibration predicted cost (0.480, 0.495, 0.505, 0.520); GSM8K test 1,310 documents only; strict common cost differences

statistics.signs: g positive favours the second term; h positive means the second term has lower generation NLL

compute.cluster: gecko partition, 3 x NVIDIA A10 24 GB per node
compute.environment: uv-created Python 3.12 virtual environment in $TMPDIR, versions pinned to the local environment

storage.home: /dcs/pg26/<cluster-user> (network file system, soft quota 30 GB): code, about 40 MB of inputs, results only
storage.tmpdir: node-local disk: environment, model, tables and caches; removed at job end

pre_submission_checks: local end-to-end smoke on RTX 5080 with 4 documents per role and 2 training updates
code and inputs uploaded by scp through warwick, SHA256 checked per file
environment created once in /tmp on the login node, imports checked, then removed
compute.resume: stage completion markers with hashes; resubmitting the same script skips completed stages and fills missing shards
compute.failure_policy: after a failure the executor fixes, re-runs the local smoke and may resubmit once; a second failure stops and is reported

model_transfer.channel_test: small file first; on failure cancel the job at once
